name: Smoke
doc: Stable-fluids smoke (semi-Lagrangian advection, Jacobi pressure projection, vorticity confinement and buoyancy on compute passes): nozzles along the floor breathe coloured smoke that rises, curls and leaves through the open top. Bass drives how much dye and force the nozzles inject, the mids lean them, and each onset puffs a twisting ring of smoke from a seeded point. Density is shaded like lit smoke and mapped through the palette.

palette.doc: the darkest stops paint the backdrop; each nozzle and puff carries its own palette position, thick smoke climbs to the top stop

cells.doc: grid height in cells (width follows the aspect)

iters.doc: Jacobi pressure iterations per step (rounded to even)

react.doc: how much the bass adds to the nozzle output

vorticity.doc: vorticity confinement: keeps small curls alive

sway.doc: how far the nozzles lean (slow wander plus the mids)

light.doc: how much the smoke is shaded by its own density gradient
